stories.headline: Samsung and SK hynix memory inventories fall below 10 days; Seoul chip stocks surge

key_facts.fact: A Sept. 7 report from KB Securities said memory inventories at Samsung Electronics and SK hynix have fallen below 10 days of supply, as AI infrastructure spending drives simultaneous demand for HBM, server DRAM and enterprise SSDs.
key_facts.excerpt: Memory inventories at Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have fallen below 10 days of supply as AI infrastructure spending drives simultaneous demand for HBM, server DRAM and enterprise SSDs, according to a Sept. 7 report from KB Securities.

key_facts.fact: KB Securities projects global hyperscaler AI infrastructure spending of about $1.3 trillion in 2027, up 60% year over year, with memory's share of that spending rising to 57% from 14% in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: AI infrastructure investment projections reaching $1.3 trillion next year, a 60% year-over-year increase... memory semiconductors' share of AI infrastructure investment will rise from 14% in 2025 to 57% in 2027

key_facts.fact: SK hynix shares closed up 8.26% at 1.783 million Korean won in Seoul on Sept. 7, their highest intraday level since June.
key_facts.excerpt: During the Asian trading session on September 7, SK Hynix shares closed up 8.26% at 1.783 million Korean won (approximately $1,324.58).

key_facts.fact: SK hynix is accelerating its shift to sixth-generation 10nm-class (1c) DRAM: about 13% of output in 2Q26, projected to hit roughly 24% in 3Q26 and 34% in 4Q26, passing Samsung's ~31%, and becoming its main node in 1Q27 ahead of HBM4E mass production in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: 1c DRAM accounted for around 10% of SK hynix's production in 1Q26 and 13% in 2Q26... projected to climb to around 24% in 3Q26 and 34% in 4Q26, surpassing Samsung's roughly 31%, before reaching 35% in 1Q27.

key_facts.fact: Mirae Asset Securities on Sept. 7 raised its target price for Samsung Electronics to 400,000 won from 370,000 and for SK hynix to 3.1 million won from 2.8 million, citing sustained HBM market expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: Kim Young-gun, analyst at Mirae Asset Securities, raised Samsung Electronics' target price from 370,000 won to 400,000 won (up 8.1%) and SK Hynix from 2.8 million won to 3.1 million won (up 10.7%) in a report on the 7th.

key_facts.fact: Mirae Asset forecasts Samsung's DRAM average selling price will rise 22.6% next year and SK hynix's 23.9%, with HBM contributing 57% bit growth and 49% ASP growth.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics' DRAM average selling price (ASP) is forecast to rise 22.6% annually next year, while SK Hynix's is expected to increase 23.9%.

stories.headline: Samsung Foundry hands more than half its 4nm capacity to HBM4 base dies

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics' foundry division allocated more than 50% of its 4-nanometer (SF4) capacity to HBM4 base-die production as of last month and plans to hold that share through the second half of 2026, supplying Nvidia, Broadcom and AMD.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics' foundry division has allocated over 50% of its 4-nanometer capacity to HBM4 base chip production as of last month. The company plans to maintain this high proportion through the second half of 2026, supplying Nvidia, Broadcom, and AMD.

key_facts.fact: Samsung began HBM4 mass production in February and expects third-quarter HBM4 revenue to more than triple sequentially, with HBM4 accounting for over 60% of total HBM revenue in the second half of the year.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung launched HBM4 mass production in February and expects third-quarter HBM4 revenue to expand more than threefold sequentially, with HBM4 accounting for over 60% of total HBM revenue in the latter half of the year.

key_facts.fact: Samsung runs SF4 at its Pyeongtaek Campus 2 (P2) and Campus 3 (P3) on lines S5 and S6; HBM4 and HBM4E customers are asking for custom logic such as memory controllers and PHYs to be moved onto the base die, freeing area on the main compute chiplet.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung operates its SF4 manufacturing at Pyeongtaek Campus 2 (P2) and Campus 3 (P3) on lines S5 and S6... customers could implement custom logic like memory controllers and PHYs directly on the HBM base die, significantly reducing the area occupied by these components on the main compute chiplet.

key_facts.fact: Samsung took 38% of HBM revenue share in Q2 2026, up from 15% a year earlier, while SK hynix's share fell from 64% to 50% as customers diversified suppliers.
key_facts.excerpt: In Q2 2026, Samsung secured 38% of the HBM market share by revenue, a notable increase from just a year ago when the company held 15%. Meanwhile, SK hynix's share has decreased from 64% in Q2 2025 to 50% in Q2 2026.

stories.headline: TSMC's 3nm set to pass 5nm as top revenue node, with record NT$400B quarterly output

key_facts.fact: TSMC's 3nm quarterly output value is projected to exceed NT$400 billion in 3Q26, a record high and more than 30% of total revenue, with 3nm expected to overtake 5nm in revenue contribution for the first time in the second half of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: 3nm is expected to overtake 5nm in revenue contribution for the first time in 2H26, with quarterly output value projected to exceed NT$400 billion in 3Q26—a record high and more than 30% of total revenue.

key_facts.fact: 5nm accounted for 33% of TSMC's 2Q26 sales while 3nm rose to 30% from 25% in 1Q26; the rising 3nm mix is expected to lift gross margin.
key_facts.excerpt: while 5nm accounted for 33% of its 2Q26 sales, 3nm's revenue contribution rose to 30% during the period from 25% in 1Q26.

key_facts.fact: Follow-on orders from Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom are driving 3nm expansion; Wedbush expects TSMC to lift monthly 3nm wafer starts to 180,000 in early 4Q26 from 150,000 in 1H26, with combined 2nm+3nm capacity above 400,000 wafers a month by 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is expected to lift monthly 3nm wafer starts to 180K in early 4Q26, up from 150K in 1H26... TSMC's combined monthly capacity for 2nm and 3nm is expected to exceed 400K wafers by 2028.

key_facts.fact: A16, TSMC's first angstrom-class process, is expected to be production-ready in 2H26, with Fab 20 in Hsinchu leading; Apple and Nvidia are expected among its first customers, and OpenAI is reportedly poised to become another.
key_facts.excerpt: A16, the company's first angstrom-class process, is expected to be production-ready in 2H26, with industry sources widely expecting Fab 20 in Hsinchu to lead production. Apple and NVIDIA are expected to be among A16's first customers, while OpenAI is reportedly poised to become another key client.

key_facts.fact: Foundry utilisation is approaching 90% and no wafer-price relief is expected before 2027, with tightness that began at leading-edge nodes now spreading into mature and specialty processes.
key_facts.excerpt: AI demand is driving a broader repricing cycle across the foundry industry in 2026. Tightness that began at leading-edge nodes is spreading into mature and specialty processes, lifting wafer prices, utilisation and downstream chip costs.

stories.headline: Taiwan pushes TSMC and 30+ firms into a silicon photonics alliance to crack co-packaged optics

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs said on Sept. 6 that it is bringing TSMC, ASE, MediaTek, Foxconn and more than 30 leading companies together into a Silicon Photonics Industry Alliance, working with SEMI.
key_facts.excerpt: 經濟部今（6）日對此指出，台灣在矽光子領域不僅有無可取代的優勢，經濟部更推動台積電、日月光、聯發科、鴻海等30多家龍頭，籌組「矽光子產業聯盟」。

key_facts.fact: The alliance's target is co-packaged optics (CPO), which the ministry calls the hardest node to crack and the technology needed to break past the 1.6T bandwidth ceiling of conventional electrical transmission.
key_facts.excerpt: 矽光子最難攻克的節點是能突破傳統電子傳輸1.6T頻寬大關的技術「共同封裝光學（CPO）」

key_facts.fact: The ministry said silicon photonics can cut power consumption by 30 to 50 percent and is key to overcoming data-transmission bottlenecks as AI compute scales.
key_facts.excerpt: The ministry said silicon photonics can cut power consumption by 30 to 50 percent and is a key technology for overcoming data transmission bottlenecks that arise as AI computing performance scales up.

key_facts.fact: Taiwan holds more than 90% of the market for advanced processes at 7nm and below and about half the global packaging and testing market, which the ministry framed as its edge in the CPO race.
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan holds more than 90 percent of the market for advanced processes at 7 nanometers and below, and about 50 percent of the global packaging and testing market.

key_facts.fact: TSMC is set to begin CPO mass production by the end of this year, with Nvidia and Broadcom also entering the CPO product market; the topic dominated Semicon Taiwan 2026, held in Taipei Sept. 2-4.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is set to begin mass production of CPO by the end of this year, with companies like NVIDIA and Broadcom also entering the CPO product market.

key_facts.fact: Separately, TSMC is reported to be planning mass production of CoPoS — chip on panel on substrate, using 310x310mm square panels instead of 12-inch wafers — in the second half of 2028, lifting material utilisation from below 70% to over 90%.
key_facts.excerpt: CoPoS uses square panels measuring 310 by 310 millimeters instead of conventional 12-inch circular wafers, and TSMC plans to raise material utilization rates from below 70 percent to more than 90 percent.

stories.headline: Anthropic's compute commitments hit $517B and 14.8 gigawatts in 11 months

key_facts.fact: The Information reported on Sept. 6 that the computing-capacity purchase agreements Anthropic signed over the past 11 months total 14.8 gigawatts and $517 billion, to be spent over the next 10 years.
key_facts.excerpt: The Information reported on the 6th that the computing capacity purchase agreements Anthropic signed over the past 11 months total 14.8 gigawatts in power terms and $517 billion in value. Anthropic will spend that amount over the next 10 years.

key_facts.fact: Before October last year Anthropic had secured only 1 to 2 gigawatts of computing capacity; 14.8 GW is roughly the output of more than 10 APR1400-class nuclear reactors, comparable to the electricity used by a metropolitan area of 26 million people.
key_facts.excerpt: Before October last year, Anthropic had secured only 1 to 2 gigawatts of computing capacity. It has added at least 14.8 gigawatts in the 11 months since. That much capacity would require running more than 10 of Korea's most advanced nuclear reactors, of the APR1400 class.

key_facts.fact: The largest single arrangement is an 11-gigawatt deal under which Amazon and Google supply capacity to Anthropic, worth more than $300 billion over 10 years; other deals include $30 billion for 1 GW of Microsoft Azure servers and up to $45 billion with SpaceX.
key_facts.excerpt: The largest of the deals struck over the 11 months is an 11-gigawatt arrangement under which Amazon and Google supply capacity to Anthropic, worth more than $300 billion over 10 years.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has also started buying AI chips directly — TPUs from Broadcom and Google in April, an AMD chip purchase agreement in July — and committed $50 billion with Fluidstack to build its own data centers in Texas and New York.
key_facts.excerpt: In April this year, it agreed to purchase tensor processing units, or TPUs, produced by Broadcom and Google, followed by a chip purchase agreement with AMD in July. In November last year, it committed $50 billion with cloud startup Fluidstack to build its own data centers in Texas and New York.

key_facts.fact: A separate tally counts five multibillion-dollar Anthropic compute contracts in 2026 — AWS ($100B/10yr), Fluidstack ($50B), Nscale ($45B), SpaceX ($45B) and Lambda ($35B) — totalling more than $275 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic's five compute contracts -- AWS ($100B/10yr), Fluidstack ($50B), Nscale ($45B), SpaceX ($45B) and Lambda ($35B) -- total more than $275B, close to 30% of its own $965B private valuation.

key_facts.fact: Korean suppliers are positioned to benefit: Samsung Electronics is expected to handle foundry work for Anthropic and manufacture its in-house chips designed by Broadcom, while SK hynix supplies HBM4 to Nvidia, a key Anthropic partner.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics is expected to play a role in foundry work for Anthropic as well as in manufacturing the company's in-house chips designed by Broadcom. SK hynix has signed a contract to supply HBM4, the latest generation of high-bandwidth memory, to Nvidia, a key Anthropic partner.
